title: Tiny, cute submarine
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#6fd8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1f8fc4'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='hullGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f2b705'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- water bubbles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='22' r='3' fill='#7fe3ff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='34' r='2' fill='#a9ecff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='14' r='1.8' fill='#a9ecff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- propeller -->
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='58' rx='4' ry='11' fill='#ff8a3d'/>
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='58' rx='11' ry='4' fill='#ff8a3d' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='58' r='3.2' fill='#ffd166'/>

  <!-- periscope -->
  <rect x='43' y='20' width='6' height='14' rx='2' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <rect x='43' y='18' width='12' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ff9a2e'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='20.5' r='1.6' fill='#6fd8ff'/>

  <!-- hull -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='58' rx='38' ry='20' fill='url(#hullGrad)'/>
  <!-- hull shading band -->
  <path d='M12 58 Q48 84 84 58 Q48 74 12 58 Z' fill='#e0a500' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- top highlight -->
  <path d='M20 48 Q48 38 76 48 Q48 44 20 48 Z' fill='#fff4b8' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- fin top -->
  <path d='M40 40 Q46 28 54 40 Z' fill='#ffb84d'/>
  <!-- fin bottom -->
  <path d='M40 76 Q46 88 54 76 Z' fill='#ffb84d'/>

  <!-- portholes -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='58' r='7' fill='#1f8fc4'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='58' r='7' fill='none' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='56' r='2.2' fill='#a9ecff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='7' fill='#1f8fc4'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='7' fill='none' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='56' r='2.2' fill='#a9ecff'/>

  <!-- little cute face eye on front -->
  <circle cx='67' cy='54' r='3' fill='#1f8fc4'/>
  <circle cx='66.2' cy='53.2' r='1' fill='#a9ecff'/>
  <path d='M63 63 Q67 66 71 63' stroke='#1f8fc4' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- light beam -->
  <polygon points='68,50 96,38 96,52' fill='#bff3ff' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
